_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Reading a file from your site

description: Return one file the site serves now, as text (utf8) or base64 for binary files, e.g. to edit it and send it back with update_site mode:'patch'. Use read_file for the served files; use read_source_file instead for the editable source tree (get_site.sourceStored). Max 5242880 bytes; get_site.filePaths lists the paths.

maxBytes.description: Per-file size cap in bytes. Default 1048576, max 5242880. A larger file fails with FILE_TOO_LARGE instead of returning truncated bytes.

name.description: Site name as shown by list_sites, e.g. my-portfolio. Provide name or siteId.

path.description: Site-relative path of the file to read (e.g. 'index.html', 'assets/main.css'). No leading slash, no '..'.

siteId.description: Site id from list_sites or get_site. Use instead of name.

name: read_file

encoding.description: utf8: `content` is the text. base64: the file is binary (image, font, ...) and `content` is base64; decode before use.

path.description: Echoes the input path, normalized (leading slash stripped, backslashes converted).

size.description: Size in bytes of the file on the pod.

title: Read a file from a deployed site
